jobs.description:
Service Technician 
 

Are you someone who enjoys solving technical problems and helping customers? Do you like working independently while also contributing ideas for improvements and new technical projects? Then this opportunity could be the right fit for you.
 

For a company based in the 
Roeselare region, we are looking for a Service Technician who enjoys a varied role. You will work in a technical environment where maintenance, installations, troubleshooting, and project work go hand in hand.
 

Your Responsibilities
 
 

• Diagnose and resolve electrical and mechanical failures at customer sites. 

• Perform preventive maintenance on a variety of technical installations. 

• Assist with the installation and commissioning of new systems. 

• Contribute to technical improvements and new projects. 

• Act as a point of contact for customers and provide technical advice when needed. 

• Ensure proper follow-up and after-sales support following completed work.  

You will work on a range of systems, including:
 
 

• Water treatment and irrigation installations such as pumps, valves, and PVC piping systems. 

• Mechanical and hydraulic installations. 

• Climate control and irrigation management systems. 

• Electrical installations, switchboards, cabling, and LED lighting systems.  

If you have an interest in design and engineering, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and optimization of electrical control panels.

Your profile
 
 

• You hold a degree in Electricity, Electromechanics, or a similar technical field. 

• You enjoy combining hands-on technical work with problem-solving and analytical thinking. 

• You are flexible and enjoy a diverse range of tasks. 

• You work accurately and take ownership of your responsibilities. 

• Experience as a service technician or in technical project work is an asset. 

• You have a good command of Dutch or English. 

• You possess a valid cat B driving license.

As a project coordinator you ensure that vehicles and mobility solutions meet all required regulations before entering the market. You operate in the homologation team; the heart of engineering, compliance, and coordination.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 

• Collecting, verifying, and managing technical documentation for approval.
 

• Following up on homologation planning and testing activities with internal stakeholders.
 

• Supporting vehicle testing with official authorities and ensuring correct execution.
 

• Managing certification processes, including Certificates of Conformity (CoC).
 

• Monitoring and interpreting EU and international regulations (UNECE, emissions, safety).
 

• Acting as a key point of contact for internal teams and European stakeholders.
 

• Handling administrative follow-up (documentation, SharePoint, reporting, guidelines).
 

• Improving processes around compliance tracking and data management.
 

 

You are structured, analytical, and able to create clarity in a complex and fast-moving environment.
 

• You have a Bachelor or Master in a technical field (Automotive, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering or similar).
 

• You are experienced in homologation, automotive compliance, testing, vehicle development, or technical documentation.
 

• You have a strong analytical mindset with advanced MS Office and SharePoint skills.
 

• You can organize and prioritize in an ad hoc, high-pressure environment.
 

• You take ownership and work autonomously towards deadlines, with accuracy and attention to detail.
 

• You have excellent communication skills in English, with good command of Dutch or French.
 

• You have perseverance and resilience in a demanding international context.

For an international organization within the medical sector based in Ghent, we are looking for an experienced Accountant to support the financial management of the Belgian operations. In this varied role, you will take broad responsibility for a range of financial and accounting processes.

Your responsibilities:

• You will manage the full accounting cycle (A to Z) for the Belgian entity and its related holding structure.
• You will be responsible for both general and analytical accounting, ensuring the accuracy and quality of financial data.
• You will act as the main point of contact for accounting and financial matters within the organization.
• You will handle monthly and annual closings and ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.
• You will prepare annual accounts and various statutory and tax filings, including VAT, Intrastat and statistical reporting.
• You will monitor outstanding receivables and payables and process payments and payroll-related accounting entries.
• You will work closely with external partners and advisors on tax matters, subsidies and other financial topics.
• You will support the annual audit process and act as a key contact during financial audits.
• You will contribute to budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis, helping to identify and explain deviations from financial targets.
• You will perform balance sheet reconciliations and controls, ensuring that discrepancies are identified and followed up appropriately.
• You will actively contribute to the improvement and optimization of financial processes, systems and procedures, working closely with the corporate finance team.

About you:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field.
• You have at least 10 years of relevant experience in accounting.
• You have a strong knowledge of general and analytical accounting.
• Experience in an international or corporate environment is considered an advantage.
• You have an excellent command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• You have strong analytical skills and a keen eye for detail.
• You are independent, proactive and solution-oriented, while also being a strong team player.
• You are able to set priorities and maintain a high level of accuracy, even when working under tight deadlines.
• You are IT-minded and comfortable working with ERP systems and Excel.

Join the Katoen Natie Team – Flexible Student Job in Logistics at the Port of Antwerp

Are you an 18  student looking for a flexible job to earn extra income while gaining valuable work experience? Katoen Natie, a leading logistics and warehousing company at the Port of Antwerp (Kallo), is currently looking for enthusiastic students to strengthen their team.

Your Role:

• 
Prepare goods for transport using a barcode scanning system

• 
Label, pack, and wrap shipments

• 
Assist with unloading incoming goods and loading outgoing orders

When can you start?

• 
Work 2 days a week (preferably not on Wednesdays)

• 
Choose from two available shifts:

• 
Early shift: 06:00 – 14:00

• 
Late shift: 14:00 – 22:00

What are we looking for?

• 
You are a student available to work on weekdays

• 
You are 18 years or older

• 
You have a positive, proactive attitude and enjoy working in a team

• 
You are reliable, motivated, and comfortable with physical tasks in a fast-paced warehouse environment

This is a fantastic opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the logistics field while balancing your studies.

Interested? Apply now and start your career with Katoen Natie!

 

• You work well on your own
• You're registered as a fulltime student at a college or university in Belgium
• Most importantly you're motivated to work!
• You're fluent in English and/or Dutch
• You consider safety and responsibility important during the job

You will work closely with one or several Client Relationship Managers and play a key role in ensuring excellent service delivery to clients.

Your responsibilities as Client Administration Officer

As a Client Administration Officer, you will provide comprehensive administrative support while ensuring a high level of service to both clients and internal stakeholders.

Administrative & Executive Support

• Managing complex agendas and coordinating meetings
• Screening and handling calls, emails, and correspondence
• Welcoming clients and visitors
• Organizing meeting rooms and coordinating logistics
• Preparing presentations and administrative documentation
• Managing and maintaining client files and archives
• Ensuring smooth communication between clients, advisors, and internal teams

Client & Financial Administration

• Supporting the opening of bank accounts in coordination with Compliance
• Following up on investment-related administrative processes
• Processing and monitoring financial transactions and investment orders

Your profile as Client Administration Officer

• Bachelor in Office Management, Management Assistant, or equivalent experience
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar administrative support role
• Experience within a professional services environment (financial services, consulting, legal, wealth management, etc.) is a strong asset
• Excellent knowledge of Dutch, with a good command of French and English
• Strong administrative and organizational skills
• Affinity with numbers and financial environments
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy

• High level of discretion and professionalism

Barman — Nando
 

Where Italian nostalgia meets real bar craft
 

Nando isn't just another restaurant — it's Nonna's kitchen, brought to life in Wilrijk, Antwerp. Retro details, honest Italian comfort food, and a room that feels like family. We're looking for a 
Barman to own our bar: someone who mixes with precision, keeps the bar running like clockwork during service, and makes every guest feel like they've pulled up a stool at Nonna's counter.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Prepare and serve drinks — cocktails, wine, coffee, aperitivo classics — accurately and efficiently 

• Welcome guests at the bar and set the tone for their evening 

• Keep the bar stocked, clean, and ready before service hits 

• Manage the pace of orders during busy periods without losing quality or friendliness 

• Coordinate with the floor team so drinks and food orders stay in sync 

• Handle guest requests and resolve minor issues with a calm, professional touch  

What you bring
 
 

• Experience as a barman/bartender in hospitality 

• Solid knowledge of classic cocktails, wine, and Italian aperitivo culture 

• Composure under pressure — busy nights don't rattle you 

• Organized, hands-on, hygiene- and detail-conscious 

• English (required), basic Dutch (required); Italian or French is a real plus  

What's in it for you
 
 

• Full-time, 38h contract 

• €15.00–€18.00 brutto/hour, negotiable based on experience 

• Meal vouchers, holiday pay, and a 13th month 

• Bike allowance and uniform provided 

• Real ownership of the bar from day one  

• Room to grow within a restaurant group that's expanding  

Restaurant is open 7/7, with 2 days off per week.
 

 Send your CV, a photo, and a short intro to 
hr@lvpgroup.be — tell us why Nando feels like your kind of room.

Air Cargo Belgium (ACB) is the official representative of the air cargo community at Brussels Airport Cargo. With over 
170 member companies, we bring together airlines, handlers, forwarders, the airport authority and other stakeholders. We connect, inspire, and 

strengthen the Brussels air cargo community through events, projects and communication.
 

Every year we organize several events that range from content-driven seminars with 20 participants, to bigger networking events like our BBQ with over 700 guests, to more leisurely events like a football tournament. Additionally, we also organize smaller activities like handing out Easter Eggs.
 

With our renewed strategy, we aim to grow from 
3,000 yearly event visitors/participants to over 7,000 in the coming years. This means more events, new ideas on how to best reach our audiences and more strong communication! To make this happen, we’re looking for a 

Community Engagement Coordinator to join our team.
 

Your Role:
As our new Community Engagement Coordinator, you will:
 

Events & Coordination
 
 

• Take the lead in event coordination from A to Z, including the planning, promotion and execution of workshops, seminars, networking events and larger community events. 

• Work closely with our Community Engagement Lead, another coordinator and the wider ACB team to ensure smooth event organization and execution. 

• Occasionally represent ACB, and support the community, at international fairs and events.  

Communication & Content
 
 

• Manage and grow ACB’s social media presence in collaboration with your community engagement colleagues, using tools such as Canva and scheduling tools to create engaging and professional content. 

• Create engaging content for newsletters, social media and online updates, highlighting community news, success stories and relevant information 

• Support the promotion and visibility of ACB’s initiatives, events and community activities.  

Community Engagement & Partnerships
 
 

• Build and maintain strong relationships with our member companies and act as a central point of contact for the community. 

• Contribute to and execute ACB’s community engagement strategy, tailored to the dynamics of the air cargo industry. 

• Gather feedback from community members and translate it into actionable recommendations to continuously improve our community engagement 

• Support the growth of memberships and sponsorships by attracting and engaging relevant stakeholders. 

• Identify and develop partnerships with relevant stakeholders to strengthen the visibility and impact of the ACB community. 

• Monitor engagement metrics and data and report on the results and impact of community engagement initiatives. 

• Act as a visible presence within the community by visiting members to share information, gather feedback, distribute materials and support campaigns or initiatives. 

Your Profile:
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in Communication, Event Management or Marketing (or similar). 

• 3–5 years of relevant professional experience (preferred). 

• Excellent writing and communication skills in English (all external communication). 

• Good knowledge of Dutch (our internal team language). 

• Good knowledge of French, as the role involves direct contact with warehouse staff. 

• Hands-on experience with graphic design (e.g. designing posters with Canva or similar) and a good eye for visual communication. 

• Social media fluency and confidence in creating and managing engaging content across platforms. 

• A people-oriented personality: you enjoy meeting people, building relationships and making new contacts. 

• A proactive attitude: you take initiative, see what needs to be done and act on it. 

• A valid category B driving licence (required for driving a van/minibus for our events). 

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills. 

• Open to learning about aviation and air cargo and connecting with major players in the industry.  

A standard desk job isn’t enough for you — you love variety, dynamism and contact with people.

jobs.occupation: Production associate | With technical skills | Strombeek-Bever | ENG
jobs.description:
We are looking for a production associate for a leading international company in the consumer goods industry.

The company is located in Strombeek-Bever.

Your responsibilities:

 

 
• You prepare, set up, and operate pilot plant equipment for testing activities. 
 
• You perform assigned tests and experiments according to established procedures. 
 
• You reconfigure, adjust, and rebuild machine components when required. 
 
• You collect, retrieve, and accurately document test data. 
 
• You verify data quality and report any anomalies to your supervisor or technical coach. 
 
• You support administrative and reporting tasks related to testing activities. 
 
• You learn and apply new testing methods with a strong focus on quality and reliability. 
 
• You collaborate closely with engineers, scientists, and technical specialists. 

 
• You have a mechanical or electromechanical education or relevant experience. 
 
• You demonstrate strong hands-on technical skills. 
 
• You are comfortable working with machinery and equipment. 
 
• You maintain a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. 
 
• You possess good computer skills and feel confident using software applications. 
 
• You communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken. 
 
• You show a proactive attitude and are willing to ask questions when needed. 
 
• You are comfortable with a role that can be physically demanding at times. 
 
• You are willing to perform tasks that may require working in less comfortable or awkward positions.

We're not looking for someone who aims to become a researcher, but who understands the context and procedures, and thrives in supporting technical research work.

Our client is a European tech group operating across mobility and renewable energy, with several complementary businesses spanning digital media, training, e-commerce, and software.The role focuses on their EV charging platform, a scale-up offering a leading consumer app, a roaming charging solution used across Europe, and a growing B2B SaaS platform for corporate fleets.As part of their international expansion, they are now appointing a Country Manager to build and lead the BeLux market.

Jobomschrijving

As Country Manager, your main responsibilities will be to :

Shape & own the BeLux market strategy

• Define the market vision and priorities for Belgium & Luxembourg, adapting the global framework to local realities.
• Build a deep understanding of drivers, barriers, competitors, and user/company behaviors to inform strategic decisions.
• Identify high-impact growth levers across B2C and B2B.

Accelerate B2C adoption & engagement

• Boost usage of the mobile app and charging access solution through creative, locally relevant activation.
• Work with Marketing on targeted campaigns and growth experiments; ensure seamless onboarding with Customer Success.
• Influence product developments by sharing market insights and feature needs with Product & Tech.

Drive B2B development & support fleet electrification

• Analyze fleet maturity and corporate charging needs to position the B2B SaaS offer effectively.
• Partner with Marketing & Sales to build a solid lead generation engine and qualify opportunities.
• Secure customer satisfaction and long-term usage through close collaboration with Customer Success and B2B Ops.

Turn strategy into execution & measurable results

• Own the BeLux KPIs and P&L: monitor performance, detect weak signals, and propose data-backed improvements.
• Deploy clear action plans and ensure cross-functional alignment for efficient execution.
• Be the operational link between market needs and central teams (Sales, Product, Tech, Marketing, CS).

Build and represent the brand in the local ecosystem

• Become the face of the company in the BeLux market: attend events, engage communities, and expand visibility.
• Develop partnerships with charging networks, installers, service providers, driver associations, and corporate stakeholders.
• Conduct initial discovery visits with prospects, validate opportunities, and coordinate handovers to internal Business Developers.

Prepare the ground for future local expansion

• Identify organizational needs as the market grows and contribute to planning a future local team (Sales, Marketing, etc.).
• Ensure continuous feedback loops to refine positioning, operations, and product-market fit.

The successful candidate will have the following qualities:

• Relevant experience in market development / new market launch / acceleration (ideally in SaaS, digital products, mobility, energy)
• Proven ability to adapt a global strategy to local dynamics and deliver measurable growth.
• Data-driven: confident with KPIs, dashboards, CRM, and translating field insights into action.
• Strong partnership-building mindset with companies, associations, and institutional stakeholders.
• Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and autonomous, with excellent cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Deep understanding of BeLux cultural and business context; EV ecosystem knowledge is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

Our client is a key player in the healthcare and social services sector. The work environment is dynamic, collaborative, and innovation‑driven, with a strong focus on modernizing its IT landscape and continuously improving operational performance. 

They are looking for a Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer to join a team responsible for the implementation, maintenance, support, and administration of the network infrastructure.
This includes network hardware, PCs and servers, printers and other peripherals, as well as the core software installed on them, both at the head office and across around one hundred remote sites.

• Implement, maintain, and administer the organization's network infrastructure, including network hardware, servers, PCs, printers, peripherals, and foundational software.
• Support the helpdesk on complex technical issues and provide advanced assistance to end users.
• Monitor system performance, conduct tuning activities, and ensure the stability and reliability of all network and server environments.
• Participate in a 24/7 on‑call rotation to guarantee operational continuity.
• Collaborate with software development teams and intervene on existing applications when needed.
• Mentor and support junior team members, sharing best practices and helping them develop technical skills.
• Analyze technical needs and contribute to the design, documentation, and implementation of new technical solutions.
• Ensure the security, resilience, and scalability of the IT infrastructure across all sites.
• 
Stay up to date with relevant technologies and propose improvements to enhance the IT landscape.

 

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field.
• Minimum 10 years of proven experience in a similar role with demonstrated progression.
• Valid driving license (Category B).
• You have a good command of technical English and a passive knowledge of Dutch (you can understand Dutch-speaking participants during meetings and work based on documentation written in Dutch).

Technical Skills

• Strong expertise in managing a Windows 11 desktop fleet and related peripherals.
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server 2019/2022.
• Good overall knowledge of Linux.
• Strong understanding of LAN/WAN configuration.
• Knowledge of relational databases.

Assets (Nice to Have)

• Experience with Aruba switches.
• Knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise 9, JBoss, Docker.
• Knowledge of PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server.
• Experience with VMware ESX virtualization.
• Basic software development knowledge.
• Experience creating MSI packages and scripting in PHP.
• 
Knowledge of Office 365 administration.

They have a strong IT department, and you will join an agile development subteam that works in short sprints on modern cloud-native software. You will take ownership within the team and work together with software engineers, UX designers, product managers, and DevOps profiles to build scalable solutions.
In addition to hands-on development in .NET, you will actively contribute to discussions around architecture, technical choices, quality, and further product development. You will use AI tools to increase your own productivity and that of the team, while remaining personally responsible for the quality and outcome of the work.
You will explore new technologies and AI applications to improve both the development process and the performance of the product. In addition, you will contribute to concrete AI use cases within the software and help the team grow through technical guidance, feedback, and knowledge sharing.

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or similar
• Strong professional experience in .NET development
• Interest in AI tools
• You work in English, Dutch is a plus

Own critical network infrastructure, work with modern technologies and shape the evolution of IT within a stable, people-focused organisation.

Our partner is a well-established Belgian organisation operating across multiple locations, with a strong focus on service, reliability and digital transformation. Its IT environment supports a broad network of sites and business operations, making availability, security and connectivity essential to its day-to-day activities.

 

As part of a growing IT Infrastructure team, you will join an environment where networking is not simply about keeping systems running: you will have the opportunity to take ownership, work on infrastructure projects and influence how the network evolves.
Network Engineer | The Role
As a Network Engineer, you will take an active role in the operational management and continuous improvement of the organisation's network environment.

• Manage and monitor LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN and firewall infrastructure across multiple locations.
• Troubleshoot complex network incidents, identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
• Work closely with external technology partners, coordinating their activities and challenging proposed solutions when needed.
• Contribute to network projects, migrations, upgrades and standardisation, while ensuring smooth change management.
• Proactively monitor performance, availability and security, using KPIs and monitoring tools to prevent service degradation and downtime.
• Contribute to automation, security and infrastructure improvements, with opportunities to expand into areas such as cloud, systems or cybersecurity.
Network Engineer | The Profile
We are looking for a technically strong Network Engineer who enjoys ownership, problem-solving and working across a broader infrastructure environment.

• 2+ years of experience in Network Engineering, Systems Engineering or IT Infrastructure.
• Solid knowledge of routing, switching, VLANs, Wi-Fi, WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP and network segmentation.
• Experience with network monitoring, incident management, troubleshooting and change management.
• Familiarity with technologies such as Cisco, Meraki, firewalls, SD-WAN or Network Access Control is a strong plus.
• Interest in automation and scripting using technologies such as PowerShell, Python, Ansible or APIs.
• Fluent in Dutch or French, professionally proficient in the other national language, with a good command of English.

What will you be doing?

During the season:

You will be part of a dynamic, energetic team that processes 45 tons of carrots per hour. Together with your colleagues, you will:

• Monitoring the operation of machines (conveyor belts, scanners, cutting and packaging systems)
• Check quality and make changes when necessary
• Show initiative and make quick decisions in difficult situations
• Detecting faults, responding immediately to breakdowns and making quick operational decisions
• Making settings and quality improvements
• Seasonal maintenance, minor repairs, and support for the maintenance department – replacing belts, lubrication, sensor adjustment, filter checks, etc.
• Working in accordance with health and safety and hygiene regulations

Out of season:

You will assist with maintenance and repairs to keep our equipment in top condition. This is not a lab job—you will be working on robust washing and sorting lines, not delicate machines in clean rooms. Practical knowledge and hands-on skills are essential.

• Solid technical knowledge and a proactive approach
• Good command of English allowing for effective communication
• Experience working with loaders or forklifts is a plus
• You enjoy working outdoors and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty
• You are responsible, independent, and solution-oriented
• Flexibility to support other departments during quieter periods
• During the high season (July, August, September), it is not possible to take vacation

jobs.occupation: Junior Lawyer - Business Criminal Law - Antwerp

Employees benefit from flexible working arrangements, a healthy work-life balance, continuous learning opportunities, and a strong team spirit supported by regular social and networking events

Working alongside experienced practitioners, you will advise and represent clients on a broad range of corporate and business criminal law matters. This role offers the opportunity to develop your expertise within a dynamic and growing team while working on complex and high-profile cases.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist clients in business and corporate criminal law matters.
• Conduct legal research and draft legal documents.
• Support and represent clients during investigations and proceedings.
• Collaborate closely with senior lawyers and partners.

Our client is an EU organization based in Brussels. Offices are reachable by public transports.

• Manage administrative mailboxes and general office correspondence.
• Register and review invoices while maintaining accurate supplier records.
• Prepare payments and support budget and expense management activities.
• Liaise with external accountants and maintain accounting documentation.
• Manage membership fees, donations and other contributions.

• Maintain well-organised administrative records and contribute to the improvement of internal procedures and workflows.

• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Good command of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
• Reliable, proactive and solution-oriented approach.

Our client is a well-established Belgian consulting company with more than 15 years of success and a strong reputation in technology consulting. Over the last few years, the company has made a strategic shift towards one of the fastest-growing markets: Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning and AI Leadership.

Today, their challenge isn't finding talent.

It's finding enough clients for the exceptional consultants already in the business.

That's where you come in.

Jobomschrijving

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and growing a portfolio of clients across Brussels and Belgium.

From first contact to long-term partnership, you'll own the entire sales cycle.

You will:

• Identify and approach new clients
• Build relationships with decision-makers and executives
• Understand business challenges and propose the right consulting solution
• Sell AI expertise
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals
• Work closely with recruiters to match the right consultants to client needs
• Follow consultants on-site and ensure long-term client satisfaction
• Continuously expand your network and market knowledge

• You know how staffing and consulting work.
• You've already sold projects, consultants, services or expertise.
• You enjoy hunting for opportunities and building lasting commercial relationships.
• You probably have:
• 2 to 6 years of experience in consulting, staffing, recruitment or IT services
• Experience developing new accounts from scratch
• A strong commercial mindset and entrepreneurial spirit
• The ability to challenge, influence and convince stakeholders
• Fluency in English, French and/or Dutch
• A passion for business development and people
• Most importantly:
• You don't wait for leads.
• You create them.

📦 Warehouse Worker in 2 Shifts Wanted – Do you enjoy active work in a dynamic environment?
 

Are you someone who likes to roll up their sleeves and enjoys an active job? For a growing logistics company in the frozen food sector, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers who want to work in a well-organised warehouse.
 

Your tasks:
 

 
• Picking products using voice picking or a scanner
 
• Preparing orders for transport
 
• Loading and unloading trucks
 
• Working with an electric pallet truck and/or reach truck 

Who are we looking for?
 

 
• You have experience as a warehouse worker or are motivated to learn
 
• You have experience with an electric pallet truck
 
• You work safely
 
• You speak Dutch or English
